articles.title: US Stock Market: JP Morgan raises S&P 500 year-end target to 8,000 on AI, earnings optimism

articles.description: Dubai's property market is entering a selective phase, with industrial rents rising significantly. Retail property also saw strong growth, driven by tourism and population increases. Office leasing volumes grew, but businesses are choosing smaller spaces. Residential transactions slowed, though villas and townhouses outperformed apartments. This nuanced market performance varies by property type and location.

articles.title: Q1 Earnings Scorecard: Strong demand drives revenue, input costs hit profits
articles.description: Sustained market demand led to impressive revenue growth in the automotive and consumer goods sectors. In contrast, while the banking sector showed better asset quality, profitability struggled due to margin challenges. Cement companies effectively preserved their margins through strategic cost management amidst rising operational costs. Overall, various sectors experienced notable revenue uplifts; however, they also faced persistent input cost hurdles.

articles.title: UPI success is a model to preserve
articles.description: With the amendment to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, which enables the government to levy charges on banks and service providers for UPI transactions, questions emerge on the central idea of free transactions envisioned under the digital regime. articles.title: In 1957, the US launched a bizarre plan to use nuclear bombs to dig canals and build harbours. It ended in 1977 after 27 tests
articles.description: Project Plowshare aimed to revolutionize construction by utilizing nuclear explosions for large-scale projects such as canals and harbors. This revolutionary idea caught the imagination of scientists and engineers alike. However, environmental hazards and the risk of radioactive contamination overshadowed its potential. As conventional methods progressed and became more viable, the idea lost its financial attractiveness, leading to the program's termination in 1977, illustrating the constraints of technological experimentation.
